calls.question: What must the main air regulator read before Line 2 is started?
sources: Check the air supply. The main air regulator next to the filler must read 6.0 bar before the line is started. If it reads less, do not start; call maintenance on extension 4410.

calls.question: How many bottles are on a full pallet?
sources: Start the conveyor at 180 bottles per minute. After 10 minutes of stable running, ramp up to 420 bottles per minute.
